text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf has claimed more than seven crowns: an unprecedented feat. She has cemented her place in history as an emperor among emperors.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What could possibly serve as a suitable reward? We think it over together during a well-deserved moment of peace.
